component.name: Terasology
component.summary: Explore and build in a modular voxel world

description.p: Terasology is an open source voxel game and a platform for experimenting with different kinds of gameplay. Explore generated worlds, build with blocks and combine modules to change the experience.
The modular engine supports community content, world generators and gameplay systems. Available modules range from crafting and survival to puzzles and other experimental game modes.

screenshot.caption: A village in a Terasology voxel world
